topic: T1_A_timing - Signal A ephemeris and timing
summary: Signal A ephemeris is settled: P = 3.182785 +- 0.000006 d, T0 = 2460998.736 +- 0.003 BJD_TDB (epoch 0, mid-exposure) from 19 transits (S6 6, S32 5, S98 8), chi2 ~9/17 (7.5-11.3/17 across three U pipelines, two search windows and the audit's own times). The pubprep 20-transit values (3.1827856, 2460998.7375, 12.6/18) are reproduced exactly; the 2.2-min T0 difference comes entirely from the one-sided S98 E-1 (same epoch, same time system). The audit's 'timing excess' (47.5/19) is an error-model artefact: its own times give 12.7/19 with injection-calibrated errors, which are justified by injections (white/red-noise errors are 1.3-6.4x too small). No TTV evidence; 95% limits ~10-13 min for P_TTV < 64 d, longer periods unconstrained. The cycle count is unique (dchi2 >= 157 with S6; ~34-61 without). S6 is valid for timing (lands +0.3 +- 5.7 min from the S6-free prediction) but not needed. Dropping S6 moves P by up to 1.0 sigma in some pipelines, so the Note's '<0.5 sigma without Sector 6' is not robust for P. Manuscript: three MINOR wording fixes (selection rule, 'no evidence of timing variations', S6 sentence). C042/C045/C058/C071/C073/C074 and the ephemeris part of C087 are resolved.

facts.quantity: Orbital period of signal A (weighted linear ephemeris, 19-transit set, injection-calibrated per-sector errors)
facts.uncertainty: 0.0000057 (formal WLS with per-sector injection SD; MC sd 5.8e-6); pipeline-to-pipeline spread of the 19-set P 3.1827821-3.1827852 (<=0.53 sigma)
facts.supersedes: 3.1827856 +- 0.0000058 (pubprep 20-set, pubprep/manuscript.tex L31; reproduced exactly: r1 pubprep_20_inj); 3.1827853 +- 0.0000027 (audit joint fit, formal error too small); 3.1827793 +- 0.0000031 (audit per-event, red-noise errors); 3.182945 (discovery grid)
facts.notes: All values (20-set 3.1827856, 19-set 3.1827821-3.1827852, U 01 global/emcee 3.1827834-3.1827858) agree within 0.9 sigma; the printed value is the U verifier 19-set fit. Rounded error 0.000006 covers statistical (5.7e-6) plus pipeline spread (sd ~1.3e-6) in quadrature (5.8e-6).

facts.supersedes: 2460998.7375 +- 0.0023 (pubprep 20-set; difference entirely due to S98 E-1, see A.T0_shift_cause); 2460998.73679 +- 0.00112 (audit joint fit, formal); 2460998.7361 +- 0.0029 (U 02 auditor 20-set R60)
facts.notes: corr(T0,P) = 0.69 at epoch 0 (r1 U02ver_19_twosided_R60.corr_T0_P). sigma_T0 0.0029 vs pubprep 0.0023: U's S98 injection SD (12.0 min, 1310 selected injections) vs pubprep 10.1 min (150 injections, selection not mirrored); U 02 F2 + verify.

facts.quantity: Cause of the 0.0015 d (2.2 min) difference between T0 = 2460998.7375 (pubprep) and 2460998.736 (U)
facts.value: Event selection: S98 E-1 (one-sided, measured +18.4..+20.5 min in 4 of 5 pipelines) pulls T0 later. Adding E-1 alone to the 19-set moves T0 from 2460998.73599 to 2460998.73755 (+2.24 min); removing E-1 and S32 E-573 from pubprep's own 20 gives 2460998.73601. Same reference epoch (epoch 0 = S98 transit at BTJD 3998.736-3998.738) and same time system (BJD_TDB, mid-exposure).

facts.value: No. The audit's own s09 per-event times give chi2 = 47.51/19 with its red-noise errors but 12.71/19 with the pubprep per-sector injection SDs (8.62/17 for the 19-set); the excess is an error-model artefact.

facts.quantity: Transit-timing variations of signal A
facts.value: No evidence. Best sinusoid permutation FAP 0.19-0.21 (U 02, 20-set); 95% semi-amplitude upper limit median 9.9 min (+-60 min search) / 13.0 min (+-144 min) for P_TTV < 64 d; 16-23 min for 64-640 d; unconstrained for > 640 d.
facts.uncertainty: limits are medians over trial periods (p90 13.9-19.0 min for P_TTV<64 d)
facts.supersedes: audit 'TTVs cannot be claimed or excluded' (UNRESOLVED_ISSUES.md L15) - superseded (error model)
facts.notes: Periodogram was run on the U 02 auditor 20-set (includes S32 E-573); not rerun on the 19-set, whose chi2 (<=11.3/17) is lower, so the no-evidence conclusion holds a fortiori. The near-7:2 super-period with the 11.13 d signal, 1/|7/P_B - 2/P_A| ~ 2480 d (arithmetic from P_A 3.182785, P_B 11.13274), falls in the unconstrained regime.

facts.value: Unique. Epoch numbering: S6 E-795..E-789, S32 E-573..E-566, S98 E-1..E14 (E0 = BTJD 3998.736). With all sectors: 3-sector BLS best 3.182784 d, every other peak within +-0.02 d >= 157 lower, S98<->S32 aliases >= 180 lower; global template fit alternatives k=+-1..3 worse by 265-349; timing chi2 at cycle offset +-1: 13203/13445 vs 12.6. facts.quantity: May Sector 6 be used for the ephemeris and cycle count?
facts.value: Yes for photometric timing (ephemeris, cycle count): S6 times agree with the S32+S98 prediction (z = 0.03), dump proximity does not bias or broaden timing, and dumps recur every 3.125 d vs P 3.1828 d so a dump systematic drifts 1.4 h per cycle and cannot mimic a periodic dip; S6 alone gives P = 3.1826 +- 0.0018 d, 32 sigma from the dump spacing. No for localization (difference images). The cycle count does not require S6.
facts.supersedes: verif 'Sector 6 is not a clean confirmation' (timing part) - see conflict X-T1-06
